name: code-window
title: Code Window
description: macOS-style window chrome for wrapping editor, terminal, or code-preview content: a bordered `bg-card` box plus an optional title bar with the three traffic-light dots, a centred monospace filename, and an actions slot.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/code-window

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/code-window.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/code-window';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/code-window

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
